pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Preview" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -f ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/proposal_draft.pdf && mkdir -p ~/Documents/PreviewTasks/
instruction: Open the multi-page PDF document `proposal_draft.pdf` located in `~/Documents/PreviewTasks/`. If it has at least two pages, reorder the document by moving the second page to become the first page. Save the changes to the original file.
